lines.zh: 我在墓碑顶跳两步，换个角度。
lines.en: I hop twice along the gravestone's top for a better angle.

lines.zh: 我走路一颠一颠，翅膀半张着。
lines.en: I bob as I walk, wings half open.

lines.zh: 我沿着栅栏横木走，爪子扣紧。
lines.en: I walk the fence rail with my claws locked on.

lines.zh: 墙头晒得暖，我多走了几步。
lines.en: The wall top is warm; I take a few extra steps.

lines.zh: 我踩着树叶，叶子几乎没动。
lines.en: I walk on leaves, and they barely stir.

lines.zh: 黑羽毛擦过石面，沙沙地响。
lines.en: My black feathers rasp against the stone.

lines.zh: 我走三步，停下来侧头听。
lines.en: Three steps, then I stop and tilt my head to listen.

lines.zh: 地上有食，我跳下去又跳上来。
lines.en: There is food below; I drop and hop back up.

lines.zh: 我不爱走平地，平地太敞亮。
lines.en: I dislike open ground; it is far too bright.

lines.zh: 我拖着影子走过一排坟。
lines.en: I drag my shadow past a row of graves.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就得重新站稳。
lines.en: Each gust makes me find my footing again.

lines.zh: 我走过你的脚印，比你轻多了。
lines.en: I cross your footprints, far lighter than you.

lines.zh: 跟着钟声走，那附近总有人。
lines.en: I walk toward the bell; people gather there.

lines.zh: 我落脚处，青苔被踩出小坑。
lines.en: Where I land, the moss takes tiny dents.

lines.zh: 我从一块碑跳到另一块碑。
lines.en: I hop from one gravestone to the next.

lines.zh: 我落在你的肩头，只一下。
lines.en: I land on your shoulder, just for a moment.

lines.zh: 我停在十字架顶端，收好翅膀。
lines.en: I perch atop the cross and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我理了理胸口的羽毛。
lines.en: I preen the feathers on my chest.

lines.zh: 我侧头，用一只眼看天。
lines.en: I tilt my head and watch the sky with one eye.

lines.zh: 我缩起一只爪，立在栅栏尖上。
lines.en: I tuck one claw and perch on the fence tip.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，没叫出声。
lines.en: I open my beak but make no sound.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛吹乱，我又理顺。
lines.en: The wind ruffles my feathers; I smooth them again.

lines.zh: 我在等一场葬礼，那是好日子。
lines.en: I wait for a funeral; those are good days.

lines.zh: 我蹲在墙头，像一块黑石头。
lines.en: I squat on the wall like a black stone.

lines.zh: 太阳太亮，我把头埋进翅膀。
lines.en: The sun is too bright; I tuck my head under a wing.

lines.zh: 远处有乌鸦叫，我没理它。
lines.en: A raven calls far off; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我换个爪子站，石头凉了。
lines.en: I shift my claws; the stone has gone cold.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，好让苔藓忘了我。
lines.en: I stay still so the moss forgets me.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，眼珠黑得发亮。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, eyes black and bright.

lines.zh: 你走近了，我不飞，只是看着。
lines.en: You come close; I do not fly, only watch.

lines.zh: 我看你手里的东西，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I look at what you hold, not at your face.

lines.zh: 你走过墓碑，我跟在后面。
lines.en: You pass the gravestones. I follow.

lines.zh: 我把头转到另一侧，再看一遍。
lines.en: I turn my head the other way and look again.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我就在你正上方。
lines.en: You look up for me; I am directly above.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛像两颗湿石子。
lines.en: My eyes are like two wet pebbles.

lines.zh: 你眨眼，我不眨。
lines.en: You blink; I do not.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你在动。
lines.en: I stare because you are moving.

lines.zh: 你走开，我的头跟着转过去。
lines.en: You walk off and my head follows.

lines.zh: 一根羽毛被打落，我记住了你。
lines.en: A feather knocked loose; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，往高处飞。
lines.en: I shriek once and climb higher.

lines.zh: 翅膀被擦到，我歪了一下。
lines.en: My wing was grazed, and I lurched.

lines.zh: 疼，但我先保住这身羽毛。
lines.en: It hurts, but I guard these feathers first.

lines.zh: 我落地时滚了半圈，又站起。
lines.en: I hit the ground, roll half a turn, and rise.

lines.zh: 你打掉了我一根飞羽。
lines.en: You knocked out one of my flight feathers.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，像块焦木。
lines.en: I curl small, like a charred log.

lines.zh: 这片羽毛留给你，别再打了。
lines.en: Take this feather and stop hitting me.

lines.zh: 我飞起来才觉得疼。
lines.en: Only once airborne do I feel the pain.

lines.zh: 我落在远处，先喘一会儿。
lines.en: I land far off and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 你手里的种子，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the seeds in your hand.

lines.zh: 有吃的？那我愿意靠近一点。
lines.en: Food? Then I am willing to come closer.

lines.zh: 我跳下墓碑，落在你脚边。
lines.en: I drop from the gravestone and land by your feet.

lines.zh: 我想落在你手边那块墓碑上吃。
lines.en: Let me eat on the tombstone beside your hand.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，退后两步。
lines.en: Set it down and step back two paces.

lines.zh: 我盯着那块面包，头一点一点。
lines.en: I fix on the bread, head bobbing.

lines.zh: 我扑下来，抢了就跑。
lines.en: I swoop, snatch it, and fly.

lines.zh: 这点不够，我还能再吃。
lines.en: That is not enough; I could eat more.

lines.zh: 我不吃你的手，只吃手里的。
lines.en: I will not eat your hand, only what it holds.

lines.zh: 你一撒手，我就知道该动了。
lines.en: The moment you let go, I know to move.

lines.zh: 你差点踩到我，我跳开了。
lines.en: You nearly stepped on me; I hopped clear.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍到你脸，抱歉。
lines.en: My wing brushed your face; apologies.

lines.zh: 我从你肩头掠过，爪子收着。
lines.en: I skim past your shoulder with claws tucked.

lines.zh: 撞上栅栏，我稳住身子继续站。
lines.en: I hit the fence, steady myself, and stay perched.

lines.zh: 你挥手赶我，我只挪了半尺。
lines.en: You shoo me and I move half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛落了你一身。
lines.en: My feathers settle all over you.

lines.zh: 撞在一起，我比你慌。
lines.en: We collide, and I am the more startled.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦过墓碑，掉了根羽毛。
lines.en: My wing scraped a tombstone and shed a feather.

lines.zh: 你退后，我才敢落回墙头。
lines.en: You step back, and only then do I return to the wall.

lines.zh: 别推，我爪子还扣着石头。
lines.en: Do not push; my claws still grip the stone.

lines.zh: 开春时我会找一只同伴。
lines.en: Come spring I will seek a companion.

lines.zh: 我们会一起修巢，用树枝和苔。
lines.en: We will build a nest together of twigs and moss.

lines.zh: 我鸣叫三声，远处就有回应。
lines.en: I call three times, and an answer comes.

lines.zh: 配偶会替我守着这片墙头。
lines.en: My mate will guard this stretch of wall for me.

lines.zh: 我们轮流孵蛋，谁也不偷懒。
lines.en: We take turns on the eggs; neither slacks.

lines.zh: 它的羽毛比我的亮一点。
lines.en: Its feathers shine a little brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，谁都不叫。
lines.en: We stand side by side, neither calling.

lines.zh: 巢在钟楼背面，风小，安全。
lines.en: The nest sits behind the belfry: sheltered and safe.

lines.zh: 雏鸟张嘴时，我们轮流喂。
lines.en: When the chicks gape, we feed them in turns.

lines.zh: 失去同伴那年，我很久不叫。
lines.en: The year I lost my mate, I stopped calling.

lines.zh: 我叼起一枚亮东西，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up something shiny, then drop it.

lines.zh: 这粒种子我藏在舌头下面。
lines.en: I tuck this seed under my tongue.

lines.zh: 我用爪子按住面包，撕成小块。
lines.en: I pin the bread with a claw and tear it small.

lines.zh: 掉落的堕落精华，我衔走了。
lines.en: I carry off the fallen essence that dropped.

lines.zh: 太重了，我叼不动整块。
lines.en: Too heavy; I cannot carry the whole piece.

lines.zh: 我捡羽毛，其实那不是我的。
lines.en: I gather a feather that is not mine.

lines.zh: 骨头渣我也收，能垫巢。
lines.en: I collect bone chips too; they line the nest.

lines.zh: 我衔着东西飞不高，慢慢来。
lines.en: Carrying this, I cannot fly high; I go slow.

lines.zh: 有人掉了硬币，我看看就走。
lines.en: Someone dropped a coin; I look and move on.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏进墙缝，记住位置。
lines.en: I hide it in a wall crack and remember the spot.

lines.zh: 有东西在坟边动，我盯住了。
lines.en: Something stirs by the grave; I lock on.

lines.zh: 我听见土响，那不是风。
lines.en: I hear the soil shift, and it is not wind.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬出来，今天有得吃。
lines.en: A beetle crawls out; dinner is served.

lines.zh: 那个人倒下了，我先到先得。
lines.en: That one has fallen; first come, first fed.

lines.zh: 我看见田里有动静，翅膀张开。
lines.en: Movement in the field; my wings open.

lines.zh: 老鼠在碑后跑，我记下路线。
lines.en: A rat runs behind the stone; I note the route.

lines.zh: 谁在翻我的巢？我听见了。
lines.en: Who is poking my nest? I heard it.

lines.zh: 面包引来别的鸟，我先到。
lines.en: Bread draws other birds; I arrive first.

lines.zh: 它受伤了，飞不快。
lines.en: It is hurt and cannot fly fast.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，等它再近一步。
lines.en: I flatten myself and wait one more step.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，落在高处。
lines.en: I circle behind it and land high.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的手，那里有食物。
lines.en: I watch its hands; food is there.

lines.zh: 我等它低头，才动。
lines.en: I wait for it to look down, then move.

lines.zh: 我的影子从它脚边滑过去。
lines.en: My shadow slides past its feet.

lines.zh: 它一抬头，我就装成石头。
lines.en: When it looks up, I become a stone.

lines.zh: 我在数它眨眼的间隙。
lines.en: I count the gaps between its blinks.

lines.zh: 再等一会，它就会背对我。
lines.en: A moment more and it will turn its back.

lines.zh: 我挪了半步，羽毛没出声。
lines.en: I shift half a step, feathers silent.

lines.zh: 这距离刚好，风也帮我。
lines.en: The distance is right, and the wind helps.

lines.zh: 它走了，我换成另一个目标。
lines.en: It left; I switch to another target.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下去，爪子抓向它手。
lines.en: I dive, claws aimed at its hand.

lines.zh: 我的喙啄在它指节上。
lines.en: My beak strikes its knuckle.

lines.zh: 我拍翅膀打它脸，趁乱抢走。
lines.en: I beat its face with my wings and snatch the prize.

lines.zh: 它挥拳，我早飞起来了。
lines.en: It swings; I am already airborne.

lines.zh: 这一啄用了全力，喙也疼。
lines.en: That peck took everything; my beak aches too.

lines.zh: 我从后面抓它耳朵，然后跑。
lines.en: I grab its ear from behind and flee.

lines.zh: 空中转半圈，我又落它肩上。
lines.en: I wheel in the air and land back on its shoulder.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的尾羽，我挣开了。
lines.en: It caught my tail feathers; I tore free.

lines.zh: 我不恋战，抢到就飞。
lines.en: I do not linger; I grab and fly.

lines.zh: 叫声是我最后的武器。
lines.en: My call is my last weapon.

lines.zh: 我从钟楼顶飞下，落在墓碑上。
lines.en: I glide from the belfry and land on a gravestone.

lines.zh: 教堂的墙头今天有点冷。
lines.en: The church wall is chilly today.

lines.zh: 这片墓地归我，我早就住下了。
lines.en: This graveyard is mine; I have long lived here.

lines.zh: 我落在栅栏上，抖掉露水。
lines.en: I settle on the fence and shake off the dew.

lines.zh: 天黑后我才从叶子里钻出来。
lines.en: I emerge from the leaves only after dark.

lines.zh: 我绕塔三圈，算是报到。
lines.en: I circle the tower thrice to announce myself.

lines.zh: 枯树最高那根枝是我的位置。
lines.en: The highest branch of the dead tree is my seat.

lines.zh: 风把雾送来，我也就到了。
lines.en: The wind brings the fog, and I arrive with it.

lines.zh: 我落在新坟的土上，土还是软的。
lines.en: I land on fresh grave soil, still soft.

lines.zh: 村口的木牌上，我站了很多年。
lines.en: I have stood on the village sign for years.

lines.zh: 火燎掉半身羽毛，烟熏得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Fire singes half my feathers; smoke blinds me.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，我半天没翻过身。
lines.en: I hit the ground and lie stunned a while.

lines.zh: 水浸透羽毛，我扑腾着往岸边挪。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers; I flounder toward the bank.

lines.zh: 炸起的土盖住我，我抖了三次。
lines.en: Blast dirt buries me; I shake it off three times.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膀，我歪歪斜斜地飞。
lines.en: An arrow tears my wing; I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 魔法打在羽毛上，冒出一股焦味。
lines.en: Magic hits my feathers and leaves a burnt smell.

lines.zh: 饿得我站不稳，还是不肯落地。
lines.en: Hunger makes me sway, but I refuse to land.

lines.zh: 雷声把我从枝头震下来。
lines.en: Thunder knocks me clean off the branch.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我连叫都来不及。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I have no time to call.
